This lesson covers Sign reading 10.2.1 Fluency, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: What do you like reading? 2. How can you show that you are observing correct punctuations?

B. At home with your parent or guardian

4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
